answer: Stop sybil swarms with a meadow work lattice: each agent earns one plot in a shared meadow only by delivering verified timber work. A trellis of three unrelated auditors checks each load; mismatch voids the plot and its harvest. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 loads at 14x honest cost each: each timber load fits one plot and one trellis check, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents work once and keep full harvest rights.
